title: The Workflow's watch treats an unanswerable container as unknown, never as dead
description: Found while repointing lifecycle invariant A2 after l6t (2026-09-24). run-workflow.ts observe() does getProcess(...).catch(() => null) and reads null as 'gone', which triggers a reboot of the orchestrator. The old container is destroyed first, so there are never two orchestrators, but A2/A6 say a container the supervisor cannot ASK is UNKNOWN, not dead: the reboot is then a guess. Distinguish 'the platform answered: no such process' from 'the question failed' (retry/hold on the latter, bounded), and make a failed question its own failure class in the feed (A9).
